name: DipoleML Obsidian
description: Self-organizing AI second brain for Obsidian + DipoleML. Drop any source and DipoleML reads, links, and files it into one connected knowledge graph of plain Markdown you own. AI note-taking, personal knowledge management (PKM), and an open-source Notion alternative. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern.
